plan.title: Cart counter not reset after removing the last item
plan.description: After adding a product and then removing it, the cart is empty but the header counter should also return to zero. The plan adds one keyboard, removes it, anchors that the cart is empty, and checks the header counter.
preconditions: buggy-shop is running at the target URL
Every execution starts from a fresh browser context, hence a new session with an empty cart
The cart list offers a control whose accessible name contains "Remove" for the single cart line

steps.description: The header cart counter starts at zero
The keyboard is in the cart
The header cart counter shows one item
The cart line for the keyboard is gone
The cart is reported as empty
The header cart counter returns to zero once the only item has been removed

metadata.symptom: After I remove the only item from my cart, the cart counter at the top of the page still says there is one item.
